dz: 佐治亚州州长詹姆斯·奥格尔索普(James Oglethorpe)开始在圣奥古斯丁围城期间试图攻取西班牙佛罗里达州,但没有成功.
de: Georgia provincial governor James Oglethorpe begins an unsuccessful attempt to take Spanish Florida during the Siege of St. Augustine.

dz: 一支由西班牙人,自由黑人和同盟军印第安人所组成的联合部队在詹金斯耳战争中在圣奥古斯丁附近的摩斯堡(英语:Siege of Mose)击败了一支英国驻军.
de: A combined force of Spanish, free blacks and allied Indians defeat a British garrison at the Siege of Fort Mose near St. Augustine during the War of Jenkins' Ear.

te: Pope Benedict XIV, previously known as Prospero Lambertini, succeeds Clement XII as the 247th Pope.
dz: 教宗本笃十四世曾被称作"普罗斯佩罗·兰贝蒂尼"(Prospero Lambertini),后继克列门十二世出任247教宗.
de: Pope Benedict XIV, previously known as Prospero Lambertini, succeeds Clement XII as the 247th Pope.

dz: 荷兰殖民者和爪哇当地人开始屠杀巴达维亚的华人，最终造成至少 10,000 人死亡。
de: Dutch colonists and Javanese natives begin a massacre of the ethnic Chinese population in Batavia, eventually killing at least 10,000.
